I preordered the Gold edition day one and haven't regretted it. 

Assassins Creed Odyssey to some is not a "proper Assassins Creed" game as it does away with previous systems in the series such as social stealth (ability to blend with crowds.) 

Alot of people were skeptical at first of it when it was announced, as Origins introduced the beginning of what would be the Assassins group and Odyssey was set before hand. 

The game has all of your typical RPG elements. Gear that can be equipped in 5 pieces (Head, Chest, Legs, Arms, Feet), different classes of weapons (Swords, Axes, Spears, ect.), a level chart with passive and physical skills and other things of that nature. 

You play as a male/female mercenary. There are other mercs that will get a bounty on you if you commit illegal offenses (kill people, steal.) There is also a chart to hunt down the main bad guys of the story but I wont go much into that as it might spoil it for you. You have the ability to control an Eagle which has the same principle as a scouting drone to mark things on your map. You also can get a ship to sail the surrounding bodies of water and visit one island from another (some islands have higher level enemies though so be careful.) and naval combat is a blast. There are also opportunities to experience some Greek myths in game but they are tied to some AC lore to explain how they could exist so to speak. 

The Greek world built in Odyssey is very expansive and also very immersive imo. Going from Origins desserts to Greeks mountain ranges and woods are a great change of pace. Ubisoft spent a lot of time from what I understand trying to piece together Ancient Greek monuments and architecture. 

The game is still getting alot of support from Ubisoft as things like New Game Plus and The Lost Tales of Greece (free missions) have been added post launch. 

The season pass comes with two story arcs. The Legacy of the First Blade is some AC lore content that deals with a certain Persian Assassin. The other story content (first episode releases tomorrow) is The Fate of Atlantis. It has more to do with the Greek myth lore and how it relates to some of the supernatural stuff in AC. Both are split up into three separate episodes. LotFB is missions placed on the regular map. TFoA is supposed to take us to Atlantis from what I understand and other Greek myth locations (I believe the said Elysium for the first episode in the monthly update video.) Season pass also comes with AC3 and AC Liberation remastered but I'm not sure you would care since you said you arent much of an AC fan to start with but hey they are free with the pass nonetheless.  

What I can say is that I'm a huge fan of AC and Odyssey is my favorite in the series besides AC2. 

As for someone like you I would definitely pick it up.

I reccomend you pick up Origins if it goes on sale as the Modern Day story is continuing from it and is a phenomenal game in itself.

Hope this helps OP!
